made: 2026-11-28 dynamics-expert; interpretation of the stage-5 A/A D1 diagnosis (edition 9 design input, record only, not a judgement)
inputs: ../first_step_period.csv, ../event_window.csv (python-expert, worktree ed8-diag), 02_params/rexome33.yaml (bottom auger level CoM / inertia, pad_bottom_center_retracted_m, head / annulus areas)

files.window_rows.csv: s1_window.py: periods t_event-0.15 .. +0.45 s of the primary monitor per label
files.residual_split.csv: s2_lever.py: rigid-body split of r into lever and window shares (estimate)
files.pair_periods.csv: s3_corrected.py: lift-adjacent period k and step period k+1 per label
files.cp95_table.csv: s3_corrected.py: one-sided 95 % Clopper-Pearson upper bound for x/310

t_rel_lift_s.sign: negative = sample before the event-leg lift

alpha_x_rad_s2 / alpha_y_rad_s2.definition: I^-1 sum (p_i - c) x (0,0,F_i), F_i = p_h A_p - p_r A_ann at the pad xy
alpha_x_rad_s2 / alpha_y_rad_s2.note: ASSUMPTION: vertical forces only (lateral bushing moments and omega^2 terms left out), bottom-auger inertia about the CoM, body = world axes

residual_kN.definition: trace r = sum F - M_eff f_z_used

lever_share_kN.definition: -M_eff lever_z (the part an ideal lever correction would remove)

window_share_kN.definition: residual - lever_share (instantaneous pressure vs 10 ms IMU mean timing, plus any model error of the alpha estimate, seal and M_eff bias)

event_leg_unloaded_at_k.definition: 1 - p_h,event leg(t_k) / p_h,event leg(first window row)

abs_dr_lever_corrected_kN.definition: |window_share_k+1 - window_share_k| (estimate of |dr| with an ideal instantaneous lever correction)

unexplained_now / unexplained_if_lever_c.definition: candidate legs with |dr| (resp. corrected) >= threshold_kN (0.5 |dp_h| A_p)
